title: Warriors
description: You can get new friends that fight for you
body:
In this modification you have new friends which can fight for and with you!: **THE WARRIORS**

You also have a new type of armour which is the **CAMO ARMOUR** which is super for hide n' seek in the forest and protects you too!
Fight with your new friends and let them fight for you!

It's an complete override of the PvP player
I hope you'll enjoy playing and fighting with your new friends in this mod!
